g.text: • library — Toolkit-managed central source in the
agent-toolkit library. Disable removes the connection,
• local — loose files have native selector controls;
filesystem packages remain read-only. Info shows paths
• npm — native Pi/npm inventory; no Toolkit
filters, not package files or bundled
Info shows each scope’s state, controls and removal
Updates use Pi package handling, not Toolkit Git
update. Running Pi sessions are unchanged.
